there_you_are.speaker: bram
there_you_are.text: There you are. Sun's nearly down and you're still blinking sleep out of your eyes.

dawn_patrol.speaker: bram
dawn_patrol.text: Dawn patrol. You, me and Wick. We walk the north edge before the mist lifts.

choices.text: What if I mess it up?

bram_eager.speaker: bram
bram_eager.text: Good. Keep that fire. Just don't let it outrun your nose.

fern_nervous.speaker: fern
fern_nervous.text: What if I mess it up?

bram_nervous.speaker: bram
bram_nervous.text: Then you mess it up with me beside you. That's what a mentor is for.

sharp.speaker: bram
sharp.text: Eat. Sleep. I want you sharp.
